entities.name: Aspergillus niger Rhamnogalacturonase B
observations: Exact full-length sequence match to UniProt P87161; 558 aa including a predicted 21-residue signal peptide.
Secreted fungal rhamnogalacturonase B, EC 3.2.1.171, hydrolyzing alpha-D-galacturonopyranosyl-(1->2)-alpha-L-rhamnopyranosyl linkages in rhamnogalacturonan.
Contains Pfam Glyco_hydro_28 (PF00295.24), residues 145-369, supporting glycoside hydrolase family 28 membership.
Reference active-site residues are position 219, annotated proton donor, and position 294.
Reference annotations include N-glycosylation sites at residues 145, 239, 254, and 321 and multiple disulfide bonds.
C-terminal residues approximately 503-558 are disordered/low complexity, likely a flexible non-catalytic region.
Sequence properties: 57,901.95 Da predicted mass, pI 4.26, and charge at pH 7 approximately -37.7.

entities.name: Pectin catabolic process
observations: Rhamnogalacturonase B is annotated as participating in extracellular pectin catabolism, particularly degradation of rhamnogalacturonan regions.

entities.name: Rhamnogalacturonase B secretion
observations: The N-terminal 21-residue signal peptide supports secretion through the fungal secretory pathway; the reference protein is annotated to the extracellular region.
